en:
So...Kokichi tells me you wish to participate 
in the seance as well, Shuichi?
Kehehe... You are most welcome to join us.

...Is what I would like to say. However, only
five, including the spiritual medium, may join.

Aw maaan, what a shame.
Well, Kee-boy, you're out.
...Why me!?

...I agree with Kokichi.
I was thinking this for a while...

Robots and seances don't mix! They're like
toothpaste and orange juice!

To be honest, I had the same thought.
Your help was appreciated...Keebo.

D-Don't any of you feel guilty for kicking me
out after forcing me to come?
That's why we're apologizing!
No one's apologized yet!

Fine, fine, our bad... Just don't get mad and
start shooting electromagnetic waves at us.
Why would I do that!?

Stop whining, Keebo... I want to start 
the seance as soon as possible.

F-Fine...but I won't forget this betrayal,
Shuichi!
<CLT=cltMIND>What did *I* do?

So now Shuichi has joined us.
First, some warnings...

Do not enter the magic circle that I've 
drawn on the floor.

It is drawn with purifying salt, so it is 
easily disturbed when stepped upon.
You drew this magic circle with salt?

I always use salt for magic circles.
It makes seances more likely to succeed.

Also, it's dark in here, so be sure 
to watch your step.

If the magic circle is broken,
not only will the seance fail...
But it may also unleash a curse.
G-Got it... I'll be careful.

I'm surprised you were able to draw this
without even looking at the picture...

I have the entire document memorized,
so this magic circle should be perfect.

Of course, I also have <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s song
memorized. You must do the same.

I have copied the words to the song 
down here. Please commit it to memory.

Everyone else has already memorized it.
After all, you'll be unable to read in the dark.
We have to memorize the lyrics now?

You're a detective, so I expect your memory
to be up to the task. Here is the melody...

<CLT=cltMIND>I listened to Kiyo sing the song and did
my best to memorize the melody and lyrics.
Alright...I think I've got it now.

Kehehe... Your memory is extraordinary.
You are, indeed, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Well then, let us begin the ritual right away.
Yaaaay! We finally get to see Angie!

Before that, let's choose a spiritual
medium. It would work best with a girl...
Then I'll do it.

I can't think of anyone but me
that Angie's spirit should go in.
...No, I'll do it.

Because if you're the spirit medium, you
won't be able to talk to Angie.
Nyeh?

You wanna talk to Angie, right?
Then I'll be the spirit medium...
That way, you can say goodbye to her.

And after you've finished saying your
goodbyes...

Keep your chin up and live life facing forward!
Survive with me and everyone else!
...Please.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko...
Also...Himiko, let me say this one thing.

Expressing your feelings is perfectly natural.
You shouldn't feel ashamed at all.

So...if you feel like crying while you're talking
to Angie, go ahead and cry your eyes out.
...You'll feel better when you do.

Well, I mean...laughing makes you feel 
better too...

And venting your anger onto something
can really cheer you up!

Train your heart by crying, laughing,
and venting your anger, Himiko.
I think you've trained too much...
Hahaha, you're probably right.

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems like the two of them
made up... That's good.

So now that we've decided on a spiritual
medium, let us begin.
Alright, Himiko! I'll see you later!

Now I would like the spirit medium, 
Tenko, to sit within the center circle...

Please be sure to walk on the path, 
so as not to disturb the magic circle.

Mm-hm... Make sure you watch your step
since it's so dark in here.

Next, you must be as a turtle 
within that circle...

Please rest your forehead upon this
stone marker I've placed here.

It's just a stone I brought from the courtyard.
Are you sure it'll work?

Certainly. It is merely needed as a 
marker for her forehead to rest upon.
Um...like this?

This may be uncomfortable, but please 
endure it until the seance is complete.

Whatever you do, you mustn't raise 
your head or change positions.
Piece of cake! I have 5-star flexibility!

Starting now, the rest of us must go to work.
There are many things left to be done.

First, we must place this iron cage atop Tenko.
I shall leave that to Shuichi and Kokichi.

And please keep in mind...walk carefully
so as not to disturb the magic circle.

O-kay, you can count on me! I may not look like
it, but I'm actually super duper strong!

U-Ugh...I shouldn't have lied...
I'm way too weak...for this kinda stuff...
It's made of iron, no wonder it's heavy...
Hold on! Don't just drop it on top of me!

I-I know... It wouldn't be very funny if a body
discovery announcement happened during this.
Please don't jinx us!

Phew, I'm tired. So next, we cover the 
basket with a white cloth, right?
I shall take that role.

Alright, everything is prepared.
Tenko...how are you doing?

Well... I can only see the floor from this 
position, but I think I'm fine!

The final step is to place the wooden 
statue of the Dog God atop the cage...

The four of us may need to do this 
together. The statue is quite heavy.
Nyeeeh! Nyeeeh...

E-Even with four people...
it's still really heavy!
Krgh! Holy crap, this weighs a ton!

No...it is not much more 
than 175 pounds...
Phew, I'm totally wiped.

I coulda used my magic to carry it 
easily...but seances and magic don't mix.

Are you sure it's okay to put something
so heavy on top of the cage?

The iron cage was made specifically 
for seances, so it can hold this weight.
Okay...I guess that's fine then.

Now, let us exit the magic circle. 
Take care to avoid disturbing it.

This is the point of no return, Tenko.
After this point, you mustn't speak.

The next time you open your mouth,
it will be Angie speaking through you.

Understood. I will not say a word until
the seance is over!

Okay, everyone!
I'll see you guys after the seance!

The rest of us shall move to the corners of 
the room. Please go to one of your choosing.
<CLT=cltMIND>We each stood in a different corner...

Now we darken the room. Kokichi and 
Shuichi are closest to the candles.

Please blow out the candles. You should 
be able to follow the walls in the dark.

So, go back to the corner of the room after
it's dark... O-kay, got it!

You needn't move, Himiko. There are
many gaps in the floor near you.
Nyeh... Got it.

Once the room is dark, I will begin 
the song. Please sing along with me.

Then, I will call out to Angie. Until 
she replies, there must be silence.

After the seance is done, Shuichi and I are 
supposed to light the candles again, right?

Correct. I brought matches from the 
warehouse, so please use those.
Okie-dokie! Then I'll blow out the candle now.

<CLT=cltMIND>I walked up to the closest candle
and blew out the flame.

<CLT=cltMIND>The room instantly fell into
complete darkness.
<CLT=cltMIND>Pitch black darkness.

<CLT=cltMIND>So dark, I couldn't even see
my own body.

<CLT=cltMIND>Overcoming my instinctual fear of the dark,
I moved along the wall back to my corner.
<CLT=cltMIND>Then began the singing...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo led us all in <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltMIND> song.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*thunk!*
<CLT=cltMIND>We finished singing the song, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought I heard an odd sound in
the middle of it. What was that?
Is <CLT=cltSTRONG>the caged child<CLT=cltNORMAL>...Angie Yonaga?

<CLT=cltMIND>He began calling. Now if the
medium answers...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
Is <CLT=cltSTRONG>the caged child<CLT=cltNORMAL>...Angie Yonaga?
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>What's...going on...?
Is <CLT=cltSTRONG>the caged child<CLT=cltNORMAL>...Angie Yonaga?
<CLT=cltMIND>...

What's wrong?
Why won't Angie answer?

Himiko...I was very clear that you were 
not to speak, yes?

But...something's weird.
Why won't she answer?
Maybe...it failed?
Let's...light the candles briefly.
What? Is that okay?
J-Just...for now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Confused, I walked along the wall
back to the candle.

<CLT=cltMIND>I managed to strike a match and
light the candle once again.
Hey, what's going on? Did it really fail?

Th-That shouldn't be the case...
The seance was perfect...

Is Angie not coming?
Is that still Tenko in there?
<CLT=cltMIND>...
...Tenko?

Ah...I told her that she mustn't speak
until the spirit enters her...

Nee-heehee... She follows orders well.
But how about we let her out for now?

Wait...dark arts such as this need to be 
started and completed the same way.

Those who remove objects from the magic circle
must be the same who brought them in.

If not...the spirit may stay 
in the medium's body.

Seeing as how this was a failure, I don't think
any spirit is sticking around...but whatever.

<CLT=cltMIND>Just like setting up, Kiyo instructed
us how to clean everything up.

<CLT=cltMIND>We were careful to remove everything
exactly in the order Kiyo directed.
Now, I will remove the sheet.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo pinched the fabric gently
and pulled it aside.
Something...is amiss...
Nyeeeh!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko ran toward the cage
at a sprint.
Himiko! I told you not to step on the—

<CLT=cltMIND>But she wasn't listening.
She jumped onto the cage, and...
T-Tenkooo!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Fueled by desperation, Himiko grabbed
the cage, lifted it up, and...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong, dong ding!*

Wh-Who would've thought...there'd be another
victim during the investigation...?

Maybe Monophanie's green puke was
predicting this tragedy...!
...BLRGHBLRBLRGHBLRBLRGH!

Oh, the puke's color is normal now!
I guess it *was* predicting this!

E-EVERYONE...PLEASE-ASSEMBLE-IN-
THE-SEANCE-ROOM...
